boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.body: This page hit an unexpected problem. Try again, or go back to the home page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.body: This page belongs to a different role. Your own tools are on your dashboard.

network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong email or password, or the account is locked for a few minutes after too many tries. If it keeps happening, ask the training office.
codes.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Choose your own password before continuing.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
codes.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
codes.ROLL_NO_TAKEN: This roll number is already in use.
codes.EMPLOYEE_CODE_TAKEN: This employee code is already in use.
codes.CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF: You cannot deactivate your own account.
codes.TRAINER_STILL_NEEDED: This trainer is the only trainer of a batch that is planned or running. Assign another trainer to it first.
codes.COURSE_IN_USE: This course has been offered, applied for or taught, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
codes.USER_IN_USE: This account already has activity, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
codes.CANNOT_DELETE_SELF: You cannot delete your own account.
codes.CANNOT_RESET_OWN_PASSWORD: Change your own password from your profile instead.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
codes.NOT_FOUND: That record could not be found.
codes.ENROLLMENT_WINDOW_CLOSED: Enrollment for one of these courses is not open right now.
codes.DUPLICATE_ENROLLMENT: You already have an active application for this training cycle.
codes.OVERLAPPING_TRAINING: Already accepted for another training that runs at the same time. A student can be in only one training at a time.
codes.TOO_MANY_PREFERENCES: You chose more courses than allowed.
codes.ENROLLMENT_NOT_EDITABLE: This application can no longer be changed.
codes.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: One or more applications cannot take this action in their current status. Nothing was changed.
codes.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: Someone else changed one of these applications. Refresh and try again.
codes.UNKNOWN_COURSE: One of the chosen courses no longer exists.
codes.COURSE_CODE_TAKEN: A course with this code already exists.
codes.CYCLE_NAME_TAKEN: A cycle with this name already exists.
codes.INVALID_DATES: Check the dates: the end must not be before the start.
codes.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: This action is still being processed. Please wait a moment.
codes.BATCH_NOT_ENDED: The batch can be closed after its end date.
codes.STUDENTS_UNDECIDED: Some students still need a completion decision. Decide them on the Completion page first.
codes.BATCH_NAME_TAKEN: This course already has a batch with that name in the cycle.
codes.CAPACITY_BELOW_ENROLLED: Capacity cannot be lower than the number of students already in the batch.
codes.COURSE_NOT_PREFERRED: The student did not choose this course.
codes.WRONG_CYCLE: The application is for a different cycle.
codes.NOT_PLACEABLE: Only approved or waitlisted applications can be placed.
codes.ALREADY_PLACED: This student is already in a batch.
codes.BATCH_NOT_PLANNED: Students can only be removed before the batch starts.
codes.NO_TRAINER: Assign at least one trainer before activating.
codes.INVALID_BATCH_STATUS: This action isn't possible in the batch's current status.
codes.LAST_TRAINER: An active batch must keep at least one trainer.
codes.PREVIEW_STALE: Applications or batches changed since this preview. Run a new preview.
codes.PREVIEW_EXPIRED: This preview has expired. Run a new preview.
codes.OUTSIDE_BATCH_DATES: Sessions must fall within the batch dates.
codes.TOO_MANY_SESSIONS: That schedule would create too many sessions. Shorten the date range.
codes.INVALID_TIMES: The session must end after it starts.
codes.TRAINER_NOT_ASSIGNED: Assign the trainer to the batch first.
codes.SESSION_NOT_SCHEDULED: Only scheduled sessions can be cancelled.
codes.SESSION_NOT_STARTED: Attendance can be marked once the session has started.
codes.EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED: The edit window has closed. Ask an administrator to make changes.
codes.ROSTER_MISMATCH: Mark every student in the batch exactly once.
codes.MARKS_OUT_OF_RANGE: Some marks are outside the allowed range. Nothing was saved.
codes.HELD_OUTSIDE_BATCH: The date must be within the batch's dates.
codes.NOT_IN_BATCH: This student is not in the batch.
codes.MAX_BELOW_RESULTS: Maximum marks cannot be below a mark already recorded.
codes.HAS_RESULTS: An assessment with recorded marks cannot be deleted.
codes.NOT_IN_TRAINING: This student is not in training.
codes.NOT_ELIGIBLE: This student does not meet the completion rules yet.
codes.ALREADY_COMPLETED: This student has already completed training.
codes.CERTIFICATE_NOT_RENDERED: The certificate PDF is not ready yet.
codes.CERTIFICATE_NOT_VALID: This certificate is no longer valid.
codes.CERTIFICATE_NOT_REISSUABLE: This certificate can't be reissued: only a valid one, or a revoked one not yet replaced, can be.
codes.COMPETENCY_CODE_TAKEN: This code is already used in the course.
codes.ASSESSMENT_NOT_IN_COURSE: Linked assessments must belong to a batch of this course.
codes.HAS_RATINGS: Students have been rated on this competency, so it can't be deleted.
codes.BELOW_REQUIRED_LEVEL: A competency can be verified only at or above its required level.
codes.VERIFIED_LOCKED: A verified competency cannot be rated below its required level.
codes.COMPETENCY_NOT_IN_COURSE: Some competencies don't belong to this batch's course.
codes.SHARE_TOO_LONG: That is longer than a share link may last.
codes.NOT_VERIFIED: Only a verified skill can be revoked.
codes.DUE_IN_PAST: The due date cannot be in the past.
codes.INVALID_OWNER: The owner must be one of the batch's trainers or an admin.
codes.COMPLETED_IN_FUTURE: The completion time cannot be in the future.
codes.SCHEDULE_CLASH: That time clashes with another session at the same venue or for the same trainer.
codes.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo or a PDF. Add videos as links.
codes.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. The limit is 10 MB.
codes.NOT_PRACTICAL: Evidence and rubrics are for practical assessments only.
codes.NO_RUBRIC: Create a rubric for this assessment before scoring.
codes.INVALID_SCORES: Scores must use the rubric criteria and levels.
codes.INVALID_KEY: That upload does not belong to this student.
codes.UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND: The upload did not finish. Please try again.
codes.ALREADY_UPLOADED: This upload link was already used. Please try again.
codes.INVALID_COMPETENCY: That competency is not part of this course.
codes.ROLE_TITLE_TAKEN: A job role with this title already exists.
codes.OPPORTUNITY_CLOSED: This opportunity is no longer open.
codes.STUDENTS_ONLY: Only students have a name in Odia.
codes.NOT_FINISHED: Placements are recorded only for students who completed training.
codes.AI_DISABLED: The training assistant is not switched on.
codes.ASSISTANT_DAILY_LIMIT: You have used all your questions for today. Try again tomorrow.
codes.ASSISTANT_BUDGET_REACHED: The assistant has reached its limit for this month.
codes.ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
codes.NO_TEXT: No text could be read from this file. Upload a PDF with selectable text or a text file.
codes.NOT_PENDING: Only materials waiting for review can be approved or rejected.
codes.BATCH_OUTSIDE_CYCLE: The batch must run within its training cycle's dates.
codes.WINDOW_AFTER_CYCLE: Applications must close by the end of the training cycle.
codes.CYCLE_HAS_BATCHES_OUTSIDE: Some batches would run outside the new dates. Change their dates first.
codes.CYCLE_HAS_WINDOWS_OUTSIDE: Some application windows would close after the new end date. Change them first.
